description: Convert between rotor speed (RPM) and relative centrifugal force (×g) for a given rotor radius, in either direction. The conversion is exact physics — RCF = ω²r/g — and the only judgement in it is which radius: a protocol's ×g conventionally means the rotor's MAXIMUM radius, and using the wrong one scales the force by the ratio of the two.

radiusCm.description: Rotor radius in cm — the maximum radius, from the rotor manual. Required: there is no typical rotor to assume.

rcf.description: Relative centrifugal force in ×g. Give this OR rpm.

rpm.description: Speed in revolutions per minute. Give this OR rcf.

name: centrifuge_conversion
title: RPM ↔ RCF converter
